internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across all 129 occurrences the root ط و ع does not resolve to a single Quran-internal nucleus; it splits into two internally-coherent but mutually unbridged fields. (1) A WILLING-COMPLIANCE family (87 occ): obey (Form IV أطاع, 72×), be-obeyed (passive يُطاع and ADJ مُطاع), the willing-vs-coerced MODE (طوعًا, always the marked pole opposed to كرهًا), nominal obedience/assent (طاعة), voluntary supererogation (Form V تطوّع, N(V) المطّوّعين), and the causative make-willing (Form II 5:30). Its antonyms are عصى (of أطاع) and كره (of طوعًا). (2) A CAPACITY field (42 occ): Form X استطاع/يستطيع 'to have the power/means to accomplish X' — will-independent, carrying no antonym pair (simply negated), predicated even of God (5:112) and inanimate idols (36:75). No single occurrence bridges the two fields; the only link ('yielding'→'ability') is etymological/derivational, which the contract bars as semantic authority. The honest result is therefore a multi-class UNRESOLVED partition, not one meaning.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: NEGATIVE BOUNDARIES: (a) Obedience (Form IV) is object-neutral and does NOT entail rightness — one 'obeys' misleading chiefs (33:67 أطعنا سادتنا وكبراءنا), most of the earth who mislead (6:116), disbelievers (3:100, 3:149); value lives in the object, never the verb. (b) أطاع is NOT hearing/perceiving — it is the enactment step after hearing, kept distinct and sequential (سمعنا وأطعنا 2:285, 24:51, 5:7), mirrored by its true antonym سمعنا وعصينا (4:46). (c) طوعًا is NOT generic 'obey' — it marks the un-coerced MANNER, invariably against كرهًا (13:15, 3:83, 41:11, 9:53), and is silent about whether any command was issued (41:11 heavens/earth 'come willingly'). (d) Capacity (Form X) does NOT entail willingness and vice versa — inability persists DESPITE desire (9:42 لو استطعنا لخرجنا; 4:129 لن تستطيعوا أن تعدلوا), and willing spending is still rejected (9:53). (e) The root denotes no neutral 'doing/motion' per se — it requires either capacity-to-do (X) or yielding-of-will (compliance family).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 5:112 — هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا مَآئِدَةً ('Is your Lord ABLE to send down a table?'): Form X predicates raw capability OF GOD, with zero possible notion of obedience or willing-yielding — falsifying any account that makes 'obey/comply' the root's core. Reinforced by 36:75 (idols لا يستطيعون نصرهم — brute incapacity, no will) and, decisively for the non-bridge, by 64:16 (فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟) where Form X supplies EXTENT (capacity) and Form IV supplies the ACT (compliance) side by side — the Quran uses them as two distinct things, not synonyms.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: The 'pliancy/yielding' unified nucleus: TwE = 'yielding', with two registers — a WILL yielding to a command (compliance) and a TASK/world yielding to an agent's effort (ability), so Form X (istifʿāl) = 'find the matter tractable' → 'be able'. It is elegant and derivationally standard and technically fits every token. It FAILS to earn a unified grade on three contract grounds: (i) it is a vague abstraction thin enough to exclude nothing, violating the narrowness principle; (ii) it is NOT Quran-internally demonstrated — no occurrence exhibits a transitional/ambiguous reading, and Form X never contrasts a 'tractability' nuance against plain capacity; (iii) it collapses at 5:112 (God as subject: 'the world yields to Him' is vacuous), at the idol cases (36:75), and at 4:25 (طول, means) / 8:60 (قوة, force), where only brute capacity/means fits and 'yielding of will' is meaningless.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The 'pliancy/yielding' unified nucleus: TwE = 'yielding', with two registers — a WILL yielding to a command (compliance) and a TASK/world yielding to an agent's effort (ability), so Form X (istifʿāl) = 'find the matter tractable' → 'be able'. It is elegant and derivationally standard and technically fits every token. It FAILS to earn a unified grade on three contract grounds: (i) it is a vague abstraction thin enough to exclude nothing, violating the narrowness principle; (ii) it is NOT Quran-internally demonstrated — no occurrence exhibits a transitional/ambiguous reading, and Form X never contrasts a 'tractability' nuance against plain capacity; (iii) it collapses at 5:112 (God as subject: 'the world yields to Him' is vacuous), at the idol cases (36:75), and at 4:25 (طول, means) / 8:60 (قوة, force), where only brute capacity/means fits and 'yielding of will' is meaningless.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B distributional, C adversarial) converged on the SAME structure: an internally-bridged willing-compliance family and a lexicalized, will-independent capacity class (Form X), with NO in-text bridge between them. Positive evidence for the non-bridge: (1) near-complementary morphological distribution — Form X ↔ ability (42/42), everything-else ↔ willing/compliance (0 crossover); (2) two distinct antonym systems in the compliance field (عصى for أطاع; كره for طوعًا) versus antonym-less negation for capacity — two antonym systems plus a negation-only predicate cannot be one meaning; (3) 64:16 uses both senses contrastively in one verse; (4) 5:112 predicates capacity of God, impossible for any 'yielding-of-will'; (5) the spelling doublet استطاعوا/اسطاعوا within 18:97 (and تستطع/تسطع across 18:78/18:82) shows Form X is one fixed lexicalized ability-unit, not a semantically live derivative. Each class, scoped ALONE, is internally CONSISTENT (and would rate STRONG on its own), but the ROOT-level unification rests only on barred etymology. Per the contract ('two+ senses with NO Quran-internal bridge => UNRESOLVED; do not force one nucleus'; 'a vague abstraction that fits everything is not useful'), the root is graded UNRESOLVED / multi-class rather than forced into a single nucleus or an over-broad 'non-resistant yielding' schema.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: OBEY — render directed compliance to a commander's directive/amr; object-neutral (God, Messenger, parents, chiefs, disbelievers, the sinful); antonym عصى; enacted AFTER and distinct from hearing (سمعنا وأطعنا).
clusters.classification_rationale: Recurrent imperative formula أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱلرَّسُولَ (3:32, 4:59, 47:33, 64:12, 5:92, 8:1, 8:20…) and prophet refrain فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ (26:108–179, 3:50, 71:3); prohibitive لَا تُطِعِ (33:1, 25:52, 68:8, 68:10, 76:24, 6:116, 29:8, 31:15, 3:100); self-referential bridge 4:80 مَّن يُطِعِ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ ٱللَّهَ. Object-neutrality (obeying misleaders 33:67, 6:116) shows rightness is in the object, not the verb.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: BE OBEYED/HEEDED — passive of Form IV marking the entitled recipient of compliance.
clusters.classification_rationale: Both tokens are Form IV passives (QAC verb_form null): 4:64 إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ (a messenger sent to be obeyed) and 40:18 وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ (no intercessor obeyed). Same compliance node, viewed from the recipient.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: muṭāʿ — 'one who is obeyed', the whose-directive-is-complied-with participle.
clusters.classification_rationale: 81:21 مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ — the entitled, obeyed one; same directed-compliance node as Form IV.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: WILLING/UN-COERCED MODE — طوعًا as the marked voluntary pole invariably opposed to كرهًا, and طائعين 'coming willingly'; antonym كره (not عصى); silent about whether any command was issued.
clusters.classification_rationale: Every طوعًا occurs against كرهًا (يسجد… طوعًا وكرهًا 13:15; أسلم… طوعًا وكرهًا 3:83; ٱئتيا طوعًا أو كرهًا 41:11; أنفقوا طوعًا أو كرهًا 9:53). طائعين (41:11:16, قالتا أتينا طائعين) answers the same verse's command, tying the manner-adverb and participle to one willing-yield sense.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ṭāʿah — nominal obedience/assent, frequently in a verbal-claim frame; a partly lexicalized formula.
clusters.classification_rationale: طَاعَةٌ مَّعْرُوفَةٌ (24:53), طَاعَةٌ وَقَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوفٌ (47:21), يَقُولُونَ طَاعَةٌ (4:81) — nominalized compliance/assent, aligned with the Form IV field; the lexicalized nominal formula is one reason the compliance family itself would cap below STRONG if scoped alone.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: VOLUNTARY SUPEREROGATION — self-yielding to good beyond obligation: تطوّع خيرًا 'volunteers good' and المطّوّعين 'the volunteers'.
clusters.classification_rationale: فَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًا (2:158, 2:184) and ٱلْمُطَّوِّعِينَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِى ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ (9:79) — the willing-yield node applied reflexively to good deeds; coheres with the compliance family (willing pole).

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: CAUSATIVE MAKE-WILLING — to render a deed something one would go along with; edges toward 'enticed/made-agreeable'.
clusters.classification_rationale: Hapax 5:30 فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ — his nafs rendered the fratricide palatable/agreeable. It is neither 'obey' nor 'able'; read carefully as the causative of the willing-yield node, not generalized. A single occurrence that mildly resists even the compliance reading (active inducement of desire rather than passive compliance), hence STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY within the compliance family.

reconciliation.rationale: Panel reconciled it as the Form II causative of willing-yielding within the compliance family, not as an independent macro-class; a hapax that adds a genuine third nuance but does not by itself create or bridge a class.

adversarial_verification.notes: No unified root-level claim was advanced (candidate_root_contribution=null). Per the contract, two-or-more senses with no Quran-internal bridge => UNRESOLVED, so a whole-root falsification run is not required. The inter-class non-bridge is documented as persisted resistance (the full Form X class in counterevidence_refs and seam hard cases) rather than as a failed unified claim; distinctiveness_ok=false records that no unified nucleus was distinctive enough to test.

Internally consistent as its OWN class, but its link to the compliance family is only etymological (barred) — hence it is the locus of the unresolved root-level split and is listed in top-level counterevidence to any unified nucleus.

supporting_evidence.verse_text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَدَايَنتُم بِدَيْنٍ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى فَٱكْتُبُوهُ وَلْيَكْتُب بَّيْنَكُمْ كَاتِبٌۢ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَلَا يَأْبَ كَاتِبٌ أَن يَكْتُبَ كَمَا عَلَّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ فَلْيَكْتُبْ وَلْيُمْلِلِ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَلْيَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ رَبَّهُۥ وَلَا يَبْخَسْ مِنْهُ شَيْـًٔا فَإِن كَانَ ٱلَّذِى عَلَيْهِ ٱلْحَقُّ سَفِيهًا أَوْ ضَعِيفًا أَوْ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ هُوَ فَلْيُمْلِلْ وَلِيُّهُۥ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱسْتَشْهِدُوا۟ شَهِيدَيْنِ مِن رِّجَالِكُمْ فَإِن لَّمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَٱمْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّن تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءِ أَن تَضِلَّ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ وَلَا يَأْبَ ٱلشُّهَدَآءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا۟ وَلَا تَسْـَٔمُوٓا۟ أَن تَكْتُبُوهُ صَغِيرًا أَوْ كَبِيرًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلِهِۦ ذَٰلِكُمْ أَقْسَطُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَأَقْوَمُ لِلشَّهَٰدَةِ وَأَدْنَىٰٓ أَلَّا تَرْتَابُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ أَن تَكُونَ تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةً تُدِيرُونَهَا بَيْنَكُمْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَلَّا تَكْتُبُوهَا وَأَشْهِدُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ وَلَا يُضَآرَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ وَإِن تَفْعَلُوا۟ فَإِنَّهُۥ فُسُوقٌۢ بِكُمْ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

independent_verification: Lenses A, B, and C independently converged on the same two-class split with only an etymological (barred) link; adversary C additionally established that 64:16 distinguishes both senses in a single verse and 5:112 predicates capacity of God, blocking unification.

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: All 129 tokens read from Tanzil verse_text plus QAC morphology: Form X uniformly 'be able' (incl. of God 5:112, of idols 36:75, of concrete tasks 18:67/2:282), Form IV uniformly directed 'obey', طوعًا always the marked pole against كرهًا (13:15, 3:83, 41:11, 9:53), طاعة nominal assent (24:53, 47:21, 4:81).
layer_attribution.derivation: Form IV = directed compliance; Form X (istifʿāl) = capacity; Form V / N(V) = voluntary supererogation; Form II = causative make-willing; nouns = willing-mode (طوعًا) and nominal obedience (طاعة). Shared derivational skeleton does NOT establish shared meaning and is not used as a bridge.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Form X استطاع is a lexicalized capacity word (doublet استطاعوا/اسطاعوا in 18:97; تستطع/تسطع across 18:78/18:82 prove one fixed unit); طاعة is a partly lexicalized nominal assent formula (4:81 يقولون طاعة, 24:53 طاعة معروفة).
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: The objects of أطاع (God, Messenger, parents, chiefs, disbelievers) are contextual and morally neutral — rightness lives in the object, not the root; this contextual coloring is explicitly NOT read into any root-level claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: The panel reconciled the Form II hapax 5:30 from a preliminary RESISTANT reading to STRUCTURAL_UNCERTAINTY within the compliance family (causative of willing-yielding), not as a third macro-class; all other clusters are internally CONSISTENT with their local readings.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The capacity class (Form X, 42/129) resists any compliance nucleus and is bridgeable to it only etymologically (barred); this un-bridged co-equal split, plus the two distinct antonym systems (عصى, كره) versus antonym-less capacity, forces an UNRESOLVED multi-class partition rather than a forced single nucleus or an over-broad 'non-resistant yielding' schema.

hard_cases.reason: Form X capacity predicated of God (هَلْ يَسْتَطِيعُ رَبُّكَ أَن يُنَزِّلَ) — incompatible with any willing-yield/compliance reading; the single sharpest blocker to a unified nucleus.

evidence_basis.statement: Form X of God can only mean 'is [He] able', so ability cannot be a species of willing-yielding/compliance; the ability class is unbridged to the compliance family.

hard_cases.reason: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ — capacity of inanimate false gods; brute incapacity with no will involved.

evidence_basis.statement: Form X applied to will-less idols is pure incapacity, confirming the capacity class is value- and will-neutral and does not reduce to compliance.

hard_cases.reason: كَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا — inability to hear; capacity, not willingness.

evidence_basis.statement: Negated Form X denotes lack of power, not refusal of will; capacity has no willing-yield residue.

hard_cases.reason: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ — Form X (extent/capacity) and Form IV (act/obey) used contrastively in ONE verse, not synonymously.

evidence_basis.statement: When both forms co-occur the Quran keeps capacity and compliance distinct, demonstrating the two fields are not one meaning modulated by context.

hard_cases.reason: ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ (contracted) alongside ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ in the same verse — a fixed lexicalized ability-word.

evidence_basis.statement: The spelling doublet within one verse shows Form X is a single lexicalized ability unit, not a semantically live derivative of the willing-yield node.

hard_cases.reason: ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًا — the full-form partner of the doublet, same 'were able' sense.

evidence_basis.statement: Both spellings mean 'were able' identically, confirming allomorphy is phonological, not a meaning split — and the class is capacity throughout.

hard_cases.reason: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُ أَن يُمِلَّ — inability to dictate; concrete capacity.

evidence_basis.statement: Form X with a concrete task complement is plain ability, with no compliance sense available.

hard_cases.reason: لَن تَسْتَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَن تَعْدِلُوا۟ — inability to be just DESPITE will; capacity axis is independent of the will axis.

evidence_basis.statement: Inability persists despite desire, proving capacity (Form X) and willingness (طوعًا/أطاع) are orthogonal axes that do not bridge.

hard_cases.reason: مَنِ ٱسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا — having the means/ability toward the way (hajj); capacity, not compliance.

evidence_basis.statement: Form X denotes having the practical means, a capacity sense with no willing-yield content.

hard_cases.reason: Form II hapax فَطَوَّعَتْ — causative 'made-agreeable/emboldened'; neither 'obey' nor 'able', a genuine third nuance within the compliance family.

evidence_basis.statement: 5:30 is the causative of willing-yielding ('render [an act] yielded-to'), an atypical single token that caps the compliance family below STRONG and is not a separate macro-class.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The resistance is not a handful of stray tokens against an otherwise-holding nucleus; it is a persisted, coherent inter-class seam. The entire Form X capacity class (42/129 ≈ 33%) resists any compliance/willing-yield nucleus and is bridgeable to it only by barred etymology, while the Form II hapax (5:30) is an atypical causative. Because two+ senses lack any Quran-internal bridge, the honest outcome is an UNRESOLVED multi-class partition; the seam-demonstrating occurrences are recorded as hard cases and the full resistant class is enumerated in counterevidence_refs.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence in which Form X استطاع (capacity) and the willing-compliance family share ONE demonstrable predicate would bridge the two classes and collapse the multi-class partition into a single nucleus; its absence is what keeps the root UNRESOLVED.
rejection_condition.search_location: Form X tokens whose complement is a will/command rather than a task (re-examine 64:16 where استطعتم and أطيعوا co-occur, plus 9:42, 3:97, 58:4), and any compliance-family token (أطاع/طوعًا/طاعة) that predicates raw practical capacity.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Read each candidate's verse_text with QAC morphology and test whether 'be able' and 'willing-yield/comply' are interchangeable salva veritate WITHIN that single occurrence — not by analogy across tokens.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Disallow etymological/derivational inference and classical-lexicon 'yielding→able' priors; forbid cross-token analogy; require the bridge to be visible inside one occurrence and to survive the 5:112 (God) and 36:75 (idol) controls.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If no single-occurrence bridge is found, the unified-nucleus hypothesis is rejected and the root stands as a multi-class UNRESOLVED partition: a willing-compliance family plus a lexicalized capacity class.

reopen_conditions: If a Form X occurrence (استطاع/يستطيع — e.g. on re-reading 64:16, 9:42, 3:97, or 58:4) is shown to trade on willing-yielding/compliance rather than brute capacity, re-open the bridge between cluster_ability and the compliance family and reconsider a single nucleus.

If any single occurrence makes 'being able' and 'complying/willing' the SAME predicate — collapsing the ability class into the طوعًا/أطاع field without the 5:112/36:75 controls falsifying it — re-open the multi-class partition toward a unified account.

If the Form II hapax 5:30 (فطوّعت) or a newly-weighted causative token demonstrates a bridge between 'make-willing' and 'make-able', reconsider the placement of cluster_causative relative to the capacity class.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: No unified root-level claim was advanced (candidate_root_contribution=null). Per the contract, two-or-more senses with no Quran-internal bridge => UNRESOLVED, so a whole-root falsification run is not required. The inter-class non-bridge is documented as persisted resistance (the full Form X class in counterevidence_refs and seam hard cases) rather than as a failed unified claim; distinctiveness_ok=false records that no unified nucleus was distinctive enough to test.
